verdict.rationale: Box AI API and Hubs offer built-in AI-generated insights: asking questions, extracting metadata, summarizing files, and querying content with enterprise permissions intact (box-docs-9, box-docs-12, box-docs-13, box-docs-26, box-docs-33). This is first-party documented and directly embedded in the product rather than requiring external tooling. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party validation of the AI insight quality and no community corroboration of these AI features specifically.
